DockDef.description: DockDef places station-wide widgets. Place is bottom or side.

ExerciseDef.description: ExerciseDef is the content of exercise.json: a task on a station, and how a run of the station is checked against it, as the function check of a grading sheet does. It holds no program: the station runs with whatever PLC is connected.

changes.description: Changes set the station up for this exercise: settings of its modules, signals moved to other pins of a terminal, and the buttons of its dock.

conditions.description: Conditions are named expressions that steps and other conditions can use by name.

rules.description: Rules say where each workpiece belongs, by its kind, family or orientation.

steps.description: Steps run in order, as the lines of a grading sheet. The first that fails ends the run.

Num.description: A number, an expression over the module's parameters as a string, such as "length - 47" or "radius * sin(45)", or true or false for 1 or 0. Angles are degrees.

PinSwap.description: PinSwap swaps what is wired to two pins of a terminal, such as Q0 and Q7 of "io.T" or of "belt/io.T", a part's terminal.

RuleDef.description: RuleDef says where workpieces that match it belong: on the transport EndsOn when they come to rest, as a slide, or waiting on WaitsAt, At mm along it or without At at its end, up to a workpiece and a half short of it where an end stop holds it, to be taken away by hand. A workpiece matches by Kind, Family and UpsideDown, where they are given. Place is how a sheet names that place, for {place} in a line.

StationChanges.description: StationChanges set a station up for an exercise, as a teacher would on the real one: the settings of its modules, the wiring at the I/O terminals, and the buttons of its dock.

docks.description: Docks, where given, replace the station's docks, as the buttons for caps instead of workpieces.

params.description: Params sets settings, by instance: a module of the station such as "magazine", or a part of one such as "belt/mid", and by the setting's id.

pins.description: Pins swaps the wires at two pins of the same kind on a terminal, as the builder's wiring view does, so that a signal reaches the PLC at another address. The names of the PLC's signals follow their sensors and actuators.

StepDef.description: StepDef is one step of an exercise's check: one of the things to do, or a check that becomes a Line of the result. In the steps of a Repeat, {kind} is the kind of that round and {place} the Place of the rule for it. - Place runs a placeWorkpiece action with Kind, and UpsideDown for one turned over. - Press presses a button or key for a moment, and Set turns one to On. - Wait lets that many seconds pass. - Take takes away by hand every workpiece that waits where its rule wants it. - Until checks that an expression holds within Within seconds, and Holds that one keeps holding for For seconds. - Repeat runs Steps once for each of its kinds. Expressions know the names of the PLC's signals as out.P1 and in.B1, states such as gate1.solenoid.position, step (the PLC's step, or -1), lost (workpieces lost off the station), hits (how many different things ran into something since the start), the exercise's conditions by name, and the functions count("slide1.slide") and count("slide1.slide", "red") for how many workpieces, or of a kind, are on a transport, at("conveyor.surface", 65) for whether one is within a mm of that point of it, loads("conveyor.surface") and loads("conveyor.surface", "carton-large") for how much the workpieces on a transport carry, such as cartons on a pallet, and rules() for whether every workpiece placed so far is where its rule wants it.

WidgetDef.description: WidgetDef is a control shown when a module is clicked, or in a station dock. Type is push, switch, lamp, fill, button or group.

state.description: lamp, and the lamp of a push

description: exercises/<id>/exercise.json: a task on a station, and the check of a run of it, line by line.
